上游鋰資源：公司通過在全球範圍內的鋰礦資         Upstream lithium resources: The Company’s worldwide lithium resource
源佈局，分別在澳大利亞、阿根廷、愛爾蘭和         footprint, including Australia, Argentina, Ireland, and Qinghai and Jiangxi
中國青海、江西等地，掌控了多處優質鋰礦資         Province in China, enables us to operate several high-quality lithium
源，形成了穩定、優質、多元化的原材料供          resources, which gives us a stable, high-quality and diverse raw materials
應體系。公司就大部分鋰礦資源簽訂了長期採         supply system. The Company has entered into long-term procurement
購協議。公司現用的主要鋰資源為澳大利亞          agreements with regard to a majority of such lithium resources. Lithium
Mount Marion項目。公司通過持續投資上游鋰   resources currently used by the Company are mainly sourced from the
資源公司及簽署長期戰略採購協議，保障與鞏         Mount Marion Project in Australia. The Company has ensured and cemented
固了上游優質鋰原材料的穩定供應。             the stable supply of upstream lithium raw materials with prime quality
                             through continuously investing in upstream lithium resource companies and
                             entering into long-term strategic procurement agreements.

鋰化合物：贛鋒生態系統的核心為鋰化合物業         Lithium compounds: The lithium compounds business segment is the
務板塊，主要產品包括(1)電池級氫氧化鋰，        core of the Ganfeng Ecosystem, mainly including (1) battery-grade lithium
(2)電池級碳酸鋰，(3)氯化鋰，(4)氟化鋰等，    hydroxide; (2) battery-grade lithium carbonate; (3) lithium chloride; (4) lithium
廣泛應用於電動汽車、便攜式電子設備等鋰電         fluoride, etc. Such lithium compounds are widely used as lithium battery
池材料及化學及製藥領域，客戶主要包括全球         materials for electric vehicles, portable electronics, as well as in chemical
電池正極材料製造商、電池供應商和汽車原始         and pharmaceutical fields. Our customers primarily consist of global battery
設備製造廠商。                      cathode material manufacturers, battery suppliers and automobile original
                             equipment manufacturers.

金屬鋰：公司的金屬鋰產品產能排名全球第          Lithium metals: The lithium metals production capacity of the Company
一。公司能夠根據客戶需要生產不同規格型號         ranks the first place globally. The Company is capable of producing lithium
及厚度的金屬鋰錠、鋰箔、鋰棒、鋰粒子、鋰         metals in the form of ingots, foil, rods, particles, alloy powder as well as
合金粉及銅鋰或鋰鋁合金箔，主要用於(1)鋰        copper lithium or lithium aluminum alloy foil in a range of sizes and thickness
電池負極材料；(2)醫藥反應催化劑；(3)合金      according to the customers’ needs, which are mainly used (1) as lithium
及其他工業品材料，客戶包括電池製造商及醫         battery anode materials; (2) as pharmaceutical catalysts; and (3) in alloys
藥企業。金屬鋰原料主要是氯化鋰，來自公司         and other industrial product materials. Our customers consist of battery
鋰化合物業務板塊及鋰電池回收業務板塊的內         manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies. Raw materials of our lithium
部供應，以及從醫藥企業含鋰催化劑溶液中回         metals are mainly lithium chloride from the internal supply of the Company’s
收的氯化鋰。                       lithium compounds and lithium battery recycling business segments as well
                             as lithium chloride recycled from the catalyst solution which we recover from
                             the pharmaceutical companies.

鋰電池：公司大部分使用自鋰化合物業務板塊         Lithium batteries: The Company produces lithium-ion batteries, mainly using
的客戶處採購的負極材料、正極材料及電解液         a majority of anodes materials, cathodes materials and electrolyte solutions
生產鋰離子電池，主要用於電動汽車、各種儲         sourced from its customers of the lithium compounds business segment.
能設備及各種消費型電子設備，包括手機、平         Such batteries are mainly used in electric vehicles, a variety of energy
板、筆記本電腦、TWS耳機、無人機等。同         storage equipment and all kinds of consumer electronic devices, such as
時，公司積極推進固態鋰電池的研發、生產和         mobile phones, tablets, laptops, TWS headsets, drones, etc.. Meanwhile,
商業化應用。                       the Company also proactively carries forward the research, development,
                             production and commercial application of solid-state lithium batteries.

鋰電池回收：電動汽車及消費型電子產品的使         Lithium battery recycling: As the use of electric vehicles and consumer
用必將帶動退役鋰電池處理的社會需求不斷增         electronic products will certainly lead to an escalating social demand for
加，公司開展鋰電池回收業務市場前景廣闊，         treatment of retired lithium batteries, the Company’s lithium battery recycling
經濟潛力巨大，並可進一步豐富了鋰原料的多         business will have a promising market as well as enormous economic
元化供應渠道，實現鋰、鎳、鈷、錳等金屬的         potential. It can also further enrich the diversified supplies of lithium raw
資源綜合循環利用。公司回收退役鋰電池業務         materials from various sources, thus realizing the comprehensive recycling
為電池生產商及電動汽車生產商提供了可持續         of the resources of metals such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese, etc.
的增值解決方案，進一步鞏固與來自電池生產         The Company’s engagement in recycling retired lithium batteries provides
業務客戶的關係。                     battery manufacturers and electric vehicles producers with sustainable
                             value-added solutions, further solidifies our relationships with customers
                             from the battery production business.

                                             MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

行業回顧                                  INDUSTRY REVIEW

1.   鋰資源市場分析                          1.   Analysis of lithium resource market

     全球鋰資源供給大部分來自鹽湖和硬巖                     The majority of global lithium resources are sourced from salt lakes

                                                                    氫燃料電池驅動的車輛；(4)獲得稅收抵免的條件：車輛必須在北美組裝；關鍵礦物必須在與

                                                                    美國有自貿協定的國家；(5)參與稅收抵免措施的汽車類別僅限於定價不超過8萬美元的電動
                                                                    卡車、貨車和SUV，以及價格不超過5.5萬美元的轎車；(6)將符合條件車輛的最低電池容量從
                                                                    4kwh增加到7kwh。

利潤分配政策                  PROFITS DISTRIBUTION POLICIES

根據本公司之公司章程，公司的利潤分配政策    According to the Articles of Association of the Company, the profits
如下：                     distribution policies of the Company are as follows:

•   利潤分配原則：公司實施積極的利潤分   •    Profit distribution principle: The Company implements a positive
    配政策，重視對投資者的合理投資回         profit distribution policy, pays attention to the reasonable return on
    報，並保持連續性和穩定性，同時兼顧        investment of investors, and maintains continuity and stability while
    公司的可持續發展。利潤分配不得超過        taking into account the sustainable development of the Company.
    累計可分配利潤的範圍，不得損害公司        The profit distribution shall not exceed the scope of accumulated
    持續經營能力；                  distributable profits and shall not impair the Company’s ability to
                             continue to operate as a going concern;

•   利潤分配形式：公司可以採取現金、股   •    Form of profit distribution: The Company may distribute dividends in
    票或者現金與股票相結合的方式分配         the form of cash, stocks or a combination of cash and stocks, and
    股利，優先採用現金分紅的利潤分配方        preferentially use cash for dividend distribution.
    式。

•   公司一般按照年度進行利潤分配，在有   •    The Company generally makes profit distribution on an annual basis.
    條件的情況下，董事會可以提議公司進        Subject to the relevant conditions, the Board may propose that the
    行中期利潤分配。                 Company make profit distribution for the interim period.

•   現金分紅比例：在滿足公司正常生產營   •    Proportion of cash dividends: To the extent that the funds for
    運所需資金的情況下，公司在當年盈利        the Company’s normal production and operation are satisfied,
    且累計未分配利潤為正值的情況下，採        the Company is profitable in the current year and the cumulative
    取現金方式分配股利，每年以現金方式        undistributed profits are positive, dividends may be distributed in
    分配的利潤應當不少於當年實現的可分        cash. The profits distributed in cash each year shall not be less than
    配利潤的10%。                 10% of distributable profits realized in the year.

     率反映了本集團「應支付」的利率，當無        requires estimation when no observable rates are available (such as
     可觀察的利率時（如就並無訂立融資交         for subsidiaries that do not enter into financing transactions) or when
     易的附屬公司而言）或當須對利率進行         it needs to be adjusted to reflect the terms and conditions of the
